fusions.name: Edge in the Braid
fusions.desc: A lash with a blade in it deals 3 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Fan of Edges
fusions.desc: Fans the bladed lash across a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Palmed Edge
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Flicked Open
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
